label: A power for the actual contingents' joint absence issues where its holder exists and gives otherwise
paraphrase: OPEN (P2-delta, analyst formulation): whatever has at w a power for the joint absence of the concrete beings contingent at w (one world lacking them all; PowerFor) can exercise it so that, at some world accessible from w, every such being is absent, the holder exists, and the holder gives being (GivesTo) to not exactly the same beings as at w. It strengthens P2-prime (906f5c39) by requiring the exercise of a power for an outcome about existence to show in what the holder gives. It does not say whether the difference is giving something new (replacement) or withholding.
